title: Angular
note: The first framework I used — I loved how easy it made building interactive apps with two-way data binding.

title: Vue.js
note: My main stack — I've been working with it for close to 5 years and I'm still in love with it.

title: React
note: Not my personal favorite, but the most widely used framework out there for good reasons.

title: Astro
note: My favorite static site generator — simple to build with and lets you mix multiple frameworks.

title: Tailwind CSS
note: My go-to CSS framework, once you get used to its philosophy.

title: Vite
note: If you ever worked with webpack, you know why I love Vite.

title: Vitest
note: A Vite-native testing framework that finally made unit testing not feel slow.

title: Nuxt
note: An incredible framework for building Vue apps — easy to start, powerful underneath.

title: Qwik
note: Resumability lets you build extremely fast apps — familiar if you know React.

title: Next.js
note: The framework that introduced me to page-based routing on top of React.

title: Remix
note: Haven't had the chance to use it much yet, but it's on my watchlist.

title: RxJS
note: Takes effort to wrap your mind around, but incredibly powerful and flexible once it clicks.
